verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for a memory/context API platform, so the axis applies. The pack does not document any capability for users to define rules that fire actions on events. Connector auto-sync via real-time webhooks is built-in inbound ingestion, and the ingestion-customization feature filters what gets indexed. Both are adjacent features, not user-defined rule-triggered actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
